title: Try 4 new interactive BTS experiences inside the Gemini app
gist: Google is launching a limited-time global partnership with K-pop group BTS that puts four interactive fan experiences inside the Gemini app, using celebrity fandom and a YouTube film to drive consumer adoption of Gemini.

insights.claim: Google Gemini is partnering with BTS to launch four interactive experiences inside the Gemini app, available globally for a limited time in select languages.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Google is buying reach into a massive global fandom to accelerate Gemini's consumer user acquisition against ChatGPT.
insights.quote: users around the world can explore four new interactive BTS features directly inside the Gemini app, available for a limited time in select languages
insights.locator: para (Google Gemini and BTS are teaming up)

insights.claim: The BTS experiences are unlocked by typing 'Unlock BTS' or '7777' into the Gemini prompt box, using a fan-recognizable code as a low-friction entry point.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Gamified unlock codes teach mainstream fans the prompt-box behavior that is core to using a conversational AI product.
insights.quote: type "Unlock BTS" or "7777" in the prompt box

insights.claim: Google released a YouTube film, 'BTS & Gemini | It starts with you,' showing members RM, JIN, SUGA, j-hope, JIMIN, V, and Jung Kook using Gemini in daily life.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Pairing product features with an aspirational celebrity film is Google's playbook to normalize everyday AI use.
insights.quote: we released a YouTube film, BTS & Gemini | It starts with you, with a look at how BTS members RM, JIN, SUGA, j-hope, JIMIN, V, and Jung Kook use Gemini in daily life

insights.claim: The features span discovering real-world prompts from BTS members, a Gemini-powered emoji song-guessing quiz, a daily tour-news digest with an auto-synced two-week schedule, and a practical Korean language lesson.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: The bundle showcases Gemini's breadth (prompting, recommendation, news summarization, language learning) inside a single themed campaign.
insights.quote: explore real-world prompts from BTS members, learn languages, follow every BTS moment, and bring creative ideas to life

insights.claim: The 'Follow along at every tour stop' feature delivers a Gemini daily digest of trending news from the past 48–72 hours plus a two-week schedule synced to the user's local time zone.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Demonstrates Gemini positioning as a real-time personalized information agent, not just a chatbot.
insights.quote: Gemini brings you a daily digest of trending news from the past 48–72 hours, alongside a two-week schedule automatically synced to your local time zone
insights.locator: list item (Follow along at every tour stop)
